headline: September 22, 2026 is the official webpage publication date for BOTH PNNL-39459 and PNNL-38817 Beta. It is not the verified V032 package availability date.
page_number_convention: PDF pages are one-based physical pages; printed report labels are given separately.

dml_four_date_distinction.location: IEEE DataPort Abstract update; current package label is DML V032
PNNL report webpage date and Published field

ratlle_separate_dates.location: PNNL report webpage date and Published field

document_identity_note: DataPort manual and PNNL beta PDF have different byte hashes. The cited date statements occur at the same physical pages in both copies. Do not call these copies byte-identical.

g5_wording_review.finding: Detailed source audit already distinguishes all four DML dates. The closure states a beta-report publication date, not explicitly a V032 package release date; no factual retraction is justified.
g5_wording_review.optional_clarification_zh: 该 beta 报告在 PNNL 官网的发布日期为 2026-09-22；报告封面为 2026 年 8 月，正文称 beta 于 7 月完成，DataPort 的 V032 可用公告为 2026-08-14。

redistribution_recommendation.preferred_user_bundle: Original audit, this date note, verified URLs, minimal necessary excerpts, and hashes; exclude raw source PDFs/text by default.

DML_V032_manual.pdf.permission_evidence: DataPort says its files are CC BY 4.0; DataCite rightsList independently gives cc-by-4.0. This documentation was obtained from that dataset current-manual link.
DML_V032_manual.pdf.status: Potentially redistributable under that dataset license with attribution and license notice; no need to bundle it. Do not imply the separate PSCAD runtime is CC-licensed.
DML_V032_manual.pdf.attribution: Brett A. Ross, Sameer Nekkalapu, Xue Lyu, Jim Follum. Electromagnetic Transient Modeling of Large Data Centers for Grid-Level Studies: Beta Release. PNNL-38817 Beta, August 2026. Current DataPort manual for DOI 10.21227/ev1a-g183. Unmodified PDF.

PNNL-39459.pdf.status: Exclude from redistribution bundle unless an applicable redistribution grant is separately established. Public download and a DOE contractor disclaimer alone do not establish a blanket license. Link the official report instead.

redistribution_recommendation.full_extracted_source_text: Apply the same caution as to the corresponding PDF; full text is not a licensing workaround.
redistribution_recommendation.arxiv_pdf_artifacts: This reviewer downloaded no arXiv PDFs into G6/review. If other workers have them, inspect each exact version license; standard arXiv non-exclusive distribution permission is granted to arXiv, not a blanket third-party republication license.
